description:
Confirm and execute a pending order. Triggers all actions in the order. Cannot be undone.

Params: order_id (string), session_token (string), idempotency_key (string?)
Returns: {results: [{action, status, tx_hash?, error?}], idempotency_key}
Errors: NO_SESSION, SESSION_EXPIRED, ORDER_NOT_FOUND, ORDER_EXPIRED, ORDER_ALREADY_CONFIRMED

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for this write. Omit to generate one; reuse the returned idempotency_key to retry safely

name: confirm_order
title: Confirm and execute an order
